items.claim: contoursIntersect counts every contour after the first as crossing itself at its closing vertex
Face arrangement merges vertices at a billionth of the largest coordinate, so small shapes far from the origin collapse
items.note: The same magnitude-scaled tolerance appears in `meshJunctions` and in the clipper's retry grid, but both are deliberate there (they absorb float32 storage error, which grows with the coordinate), so I left them alone.

items.claim: Straight-line booleans fill the overlap of partly overlapping contours, ignoring the fill rule
items.note: Rings that touch or cross are now resolved by the path's fill rule, through the same cut machinery `curveBoolean` uses, before they are nested. This also fixes the knife's union of such paths.

items.claim: contoursIntersect reports every path with two or more contours as self-crossing
items.note: duplicate of A's contoursIntersect finding, c72f47a5dc

items.claim: Clipper fallback flattens curves at a fixed 0.5 units whatever the input's size
items.note: Both fallbacks (`boolean` and `pathTrim`) now flatten at a ten-thousandth of the inputs' extent, capped at 0.5.

items.claim: snipPathByPolyline counts a crossing at a closed cutter's first point twice and drops it
pathFaceArrangement reports a face's edge along a dropped covered sliver as bordering uncovered space
`flattenTolerance: 0` drops straight cubics from the face arrangement
items.note: Strict call: a value that is not a positive finite number throws a `RangeError`. Recorded in `docs/unruled.md` under "Audit round forty-nine".
